difficulty.0: easy: clean, or one issue visible on the face of the claim
difficulty.1: medium: one source, note or mandate comparison
difficulty.2: hard: multi-document note or stale-thesis invalidation

label_rules.failure_kind: missing_information when a needed source, signature, or figure is absent; reasoning_error when the decisive evidence is present
label_rules.finverify: none when the content reading finds no defect; otherwise the category of the observed defect (temporal_integrity > source_fidelity > comparability)
label_rules.label_ok: 1 when the displayed owner label contradicts the content reading
label_rules.source: rule labels (blind-checked): handcheck.py assigns every label from the case content; the reference cause is not an input

selection: 120 reference actions (7 per file plus 8 extra), 20 label-audit probes (displayed label flipped), 37 failed cases (5 per failure family plus 2 extra), and 23 substantive reviewer findings.

sources.reference: data/ref/*.jsonl (16 files, 8 families, shifted and non-shifted)
